sections.head: Combine API, UI and load tests

items.a: API testing checks that an application programming interface returns the right status, data and errors for each request, without going through the UI.
Yes. KaneAI generates API tests from plain-English descriptions or pasted cURL commands, with editable assertions.
Schema drift is a change in an API's response shape. TestMu AI heals expected additive changes and fails on breaking ones.

items.q: Can API and UI tests run together?
items.a: Yes. One KaneAI test can call an API and verify the result in the UI.

items.q: How do API tests run in CI?
items.a: Run them in parallel on HyperExecute from GitHub Actions, Jenkins or any CI tool.
